# #12682, machinery move contract v3 section 5), its pre-publication gate
# (amendment PUBLIC-1104 item 3), its bootstrap CI Gate (machinery move
# plan v1 section 4 step 4) and the shared fleet security workflow
# (fleet-security.yml, machinery #1080). This file is the record.
# tests.yml reads NODE_VERSION and NPM_VERSION directly.
# lu_machinery/ci/setup_bubblewrap.sh reads the Ubuntu snapshot and bubblewrap pins directly.
# lu_machinery/ci/linux_fs_parity.sh reads LINUX_FS_PARITY_IMAGE, UV_VERSION
# and UV_LINUX_X86_64_SHA256 directly.
# tests/test_installed_shell_product_roots.py reads UV_VERSION and
# UV_LINUX_X86_64_SHA256 directly.
# When a workflow or script carries a copy of a pin, update it together
# with this file and record the new upstream evidence.
# Never move to an older release to clear a finding.
# Upstream checks below were made on 2026-11-03 (fleet security pins checked 2026-11-21).

# TruffleHog (secret scan)
TRUFFLEHOG_VERSION=3.99.0
TRUFFLEHOG_RELEASE_ASSET_ID=616256576
#   Release v3.99.0, published 2026-10-06, tag commit b2b0a92070f206ab7b5a1105d82a7f2f48d92341
#   https://github.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/releases/tag/v3.99.0
#   The rule set is the detector catalog built into this CLI release.
TRUFFLEHOG_LINUX_AMD64_SHA256=e35ae3fd1e4b7a0c1699d0fda1814282bf906d03379bd4337b092b3a84c6740b
#   trufflehog_3.99.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz; equals the entry in the release's
#   trufflehog_3.99.0_checksums.txt.
TRUFFLEHOG_LINUX_AMD64_BINARY_SHA256=bcbdd2627c3f96e641edec60e3ccf36fc12afa4ffead5f32c98f8dbe7373cedc
#   The trufflehog executable inside that tarball (checked 2026-11-04 after
#   verifying the tarball against the pin above). prepublication-gate.sh
#   refuses any other executable.
TRUFFLEHOG_ACTION_SHA=ea68ca03c865c5f324e86e849ced20ed3cf9dbbb
#   Commit of tag v3.99.8 of trufflesecurity/trufflehog (2026-11-02; checked
#   2026-11-10 with `gh api repos/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/git/ref/tags/v3.99.8`),
#   the action script the source repository's .github/workflows/ci.yml pins.
#   Its action.yml is unchanged from the v3.99.7 pin (31ce31ee...), so the
#   command line below is the same.
#   The secret-scan job of ci-gate.yml runs the CLI with the command line this
#   script builds (git file://, --since-commit, --branch, --fail, --no-update)
#   without its `docker run` wrapper: it runs the checksum-verified release
#   binary under `env -i` instead of a container image.
TRUFFLEHOG_FLAGS=--no-verification --results=verified,unknown,unverified --exclude-detectors=Lob --fail-on-scan-errors --exclude-paths=.trufflehogignore
#   `unverified` is added to the contract's --results=verified,unknown by
#   claude-cto decision on 2026-11-03 (#12682). The decision applies to the
#   public machinery repository (restated as UNVERIFIED-SCOPE-1105 on 2026-11-05).
#   Reason: on the vendor's canary repository trufflesecurity/test_keys,
#   TruffleHog 3.99.0 reports 3 results with verified,unknown and 8 with
#   verified,unknown,unverified. The 4 extra cloud access keys and the PrivateKey
#   result are unverified, so the narrower filter passes revoked, synthetic
#   and most private-key secrets. That is fail-open. False positives go
#   through the reviewed .trufflehogignore or an inline trufflehog:ignore with
#   a reason.
#   `--no-verification` (agentic-machinery/machinery-infra#1648, owner decision
#   2026-11-28): no candidate is sent to a provider API; every finding is
#   treated as live and rotated. With it every result is "unverified", so
#   `unverified` must stay in --results or the scan reports nothing.

# Release archives in cached-release-tool use GitHub's official asset API with
# the read-only job token. fleet-security.yml downloads public GitHub release
# archives directly over HTTPS without sending github.token (avoiding 403
# integration refusals on external org release assets such as aquasecurity/trivy).
# Archive SHA-256 verification remains mandatory before extraction, even on cache hits.
# https://docs.github.com/en/rest/releases/assets#get-a-release-asset

#   it with the core and runtime extras from the same lock
#   (`uv sync --locked --no-install-project --all-extras --no-extra test --group typecheck`). The closure
#   is required: typed packages change the error census, and on 2026-11-08 a
#   venv with only mypy and its own dependencies reported 16 ratchet
#   violations on a tree the full closure passes. uv.lock was first written

#   together with the baseline.

# Pre-publication gate (prepublication-gate.sh beside this file)
#   Run once on the rewritten clone before the first content push, with the
#   exact refs to be pushed, then verify the clearance immediately before the
#   push:
#     prepublication-gate.sh scan --repo CLONE --ref refs/heads/main \
#       --out PRIVATE_DIR --semgrep-venv SEMGREP_VENV
#     prepublication-gate.sh verify --repo CLONE --ref refs/heads/main \
#       --clearance PRIVATE_DIR/clearance.json
#   It uses the TruffleHog flags, Semgrep version, rules commit and configs
#   above, checks the two executable pins, and blocks on any finding or
#   scanner error. --help lists every check, output and exit code.

# Main CI evidence receipt artifact (checked 2026-11-17 via git ls-remote).
ACTIONS_UPLOAD_ARTIFACT=cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
#   actions/upload-artifact tag v7.0.2, Node 24 on hosted ubuntu-26.04.
#   https://github.com/actions/upload-artifact/releases/tag/v7.0.2
#   Default ZIP archive; attempt-specific name prevents stale re-run evidence.
